scripts.test: vitest run --config vitest.config.js && npm run test:worker && npm run test:ui
scripts.validate:data: node scripts/generate-data.mjs --check && node scripts/validate-data.mjs && node scripts/validate-realworld-intake.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run validate:data && npm run test && npm run build && node scripts/verify-production-story-data.mjs
scripts.check:worker: wrangler types --check --include-runtime false --config wrangler.timeline.jsonc --env-file /dev/null && tsc -p workers/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply gakumasu-timeline-prod --local --config wrangler.timeline.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply gakumasu-timeline-prod --remote --config wrangler.timeline.jsonc
scripts.deploy: node -e "console.error('Deployment is handled by GitHub Actions to rectaris/rectaris.github.io under /timeline/.'); process.exit(1)"
scripts.deploy:curiretas: npm run build:curiretas && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.timeline.jsonc
